from pathlib import Path
import sys, unittest
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path("scripts").resolve()))
import test_cli_file_input
test_cli_file_input.CLI = Path("/tmp/storytelling-ske06-layout-target/debug/storytelling")
assert test_cli_file_input.CLI.is_file()
suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.discover("scripts", pattern="test_*.py")
result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite)
raise SystemExit(0 if result.wasSuccessful() else 1)
